ios.desc:
A UNIQUE WEATHER FORECAST VISUALISATION
While most weather forecasting apps rely solely on free global models, Windy has gone a step further by investing heavily in the most accurate weather models available, always at the highest possible resolution, to deliver you the most accurate forecasts in the world.

LIVE WEATHER APP - WEATHER RADAR & SATELLITE
(Now with Precipitation Type & Lightning tracker)
Radar is a highly valued tool for weather forecasting. To provide you with the most accurate radar imagery, we constantly expand our resources so that rain, snow, and storms don't catch you by surprise.
Trusted radar sources include NOAA, Met Office, Météo France, DWD, JMA, IMD, BoM & more.
The global satellite composite is created from NOAA, EUMETSAT & Himawari data.

MORE THAN 50 WEATHER MAPS
- Rain radar, Satellite and a unique combined layer of Radar & Satellite images (blue, infrared, visible)
- Hurricane tracker, Weather warnings & Extreme forecast
- Wind forecast: Wind speed, Wind gusts & Accumulation, models comparison, data from live Weather stations
- Temperature: Humidity, Pressure, Dew point, live data from Weather stations
- Rain: Thunder & storms, Rain accumulation, Thunderstorms, Precipitation type, CAPE-index
- Aviation: Clouds, Cloud tops, Cloud base, Visibility (LIFR, IFR, MVFR, VFR), Fog, Icing, Clear air turbulence, Thermals, Freezing altitude
- Marine Forecast: Waves, Swell, Wave power, Tide forecast, Currents, Sea temperature
- Solar activity: Solar power, UV index, Wet-bulb temperature
- Snow: Snow depth, New snow, Snow density
- Air Quality: Air Quality Index (AQI) with Pollen (CAMS), NO2, PM 2.5, Aerosol, SO2, Ozone layer, Surface ozone, CO concentration, Dust mass
- Soil moisture, Moisture anomaly, Drought intensity, Fire Danger, Fuel moisture

MORE THAN 15 WEATHER MODELS
Global weather models:
- meteoblue - AI forecast
- ECMWF
- GFS by NOAA
- ICON by DWD

Local weather models:
- HRRR by NOAA
- NAM by NOAA
- HRDPS by MSC
- ICON-EU by DWD
- ICON-D2 by DWD
- UKV by Met Office
- AROME-HD by Météo France
- ALADIN by CHMI
- NEMS by meteoblue
- MSM by JMA
- ACCESS-C by BoM

LIVE RAIN, STORM ALERTS & CUSTOM WEATHER ALERTS
Want to know before the storm hits near you while you hike, bike or spend time outdoors? You can now access live weather alerts or set up your custom weather alert for wind, sunshine, or new snow.

HURRICANE TRACKER FOR STORM TRACKING
With Windy's hurricane tracker, you can track the past and projected path of a hurricane

android.desc:
Windy.com is an extraordinary tool for weather forecast visualization. It’s fast, intuitive, detailed and most accurate weather app trusted by professional pilots, paragliders, skydivers, kiters, surfers, boaters, fishermen, storm chasers and weather geeks, and even by governments, army staffs and rescue teams. Whether you are tracking a tropical storm or potential severe weather, planning a trip, pursuing your favourite outdoor sport, or you just need to know if it will rain this weekend, Windy provides you with the most up-to-date weather forecast around. The uniqueness of Windy lies in the fact that it brings you better quality information than the other weather apps’ pro-features, while our product is absolutely free and even without ads. Powerful, smooth and fluid presentation makes weather forecasting a real pleasure!

All forecast models at once

Windy brings you all the world’s leading weather forecasting models: global ECMWF, GFS and ICON plus local NEMS, AROME, UKV, ICON EU and ICON-D2 (for Europe). Furthermore NAM and HRRR (for the USA) and ACCESS (for Australia).

51 weather maps

From wind, rain, temperature and pressure to swell or CAPE index, with Windy you will have all convenient weather maps just at your fingertips.

Satellite & Doppler radar

Global satellite composite is created from NOAA, EUMETSAT, and Himawari. The image frequency is 5-15 minutes based on area. Doppler radar covers large parts of Europe, America, Asia, and Australia.

Point of interests

Windy lets you display observed wind and temperature, forecasted weather, airports around the World, collection of 55 000 weather webcams and 1500+ paragliding spots right on the map.

Fully customizable

Add your favorite weather maps to quick menu, customize color palette on any layer, access advanced options in the settings. All that makes Windy the weather geek’s tool of choice.

Features and data sources

✅ All leading weather forecast models: ECMWF, GFS by NOAA, ICON and meteoblue mLM ✅ Several local weather models NEMS, ICON EU and ICON-D2, AROME, NAM, HRRR, ACCESS ✅ High-Res satellite composite ✅ Forecast model comparison ✅ 51 global weather maps ✅ Global weather radar network with precipitation type ✅ 16 altitude levels from the surface to 13.5km/FL450 ✅ Metric or imperial units ✅ Detailed weather forecast for any location (temperature, rain and snow a

For those of you looking for an alternative, I'd recommend Windy[0][1][2]. It's UI can be slightly quirky but the weather models, features and visualisations are superb. If you're specifically after marine and wind forecasts, PredictWind[3] is about as good as it gets.

[1] Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.windyty.android

[2] iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/windy-com/id1161387262
